name: opt1.k
model:
class OptTest1 {
  cost:Int
  performance:Int

  req cost >= 0

  req cost <= 1000

  req performance >= 0

  req performance <= 100

  req performance <= cost / 10

  req performance >= 50
  minimize cost
}

main:OptTest1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptTest1 (mk-OptTest1 (cost Int)(performance Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-OptTest1 (sel-OptTest1 OptTest1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptTest1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptTest1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptTest1 ((this Ref)) OptTest1
  (sel-OptTest1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptTest1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OptTest1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -------------------------------
;   Getters for class OptTest1:
; -------------------------------

; --- getters for OptTest1.cost: ---

(define-fun OptTest1!cost ((this Ref)) Int
  (cost (deref-OptTest1 this))
)

; --- getters for OptTest1.performance: ---

(define-fun OptTest1!performance ((this Ref)) Int
  (performance (deref-OptTest1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OptTest1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptTest1:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-OptTest1 OptTest1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptTest1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptTest1!cost this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptTest1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptTest1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptTest1!cost this) 1000)
)

(assert (! (OptTest1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun OptTest1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptTest1!performance this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptTest1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun OptTest1.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptTest1!performance this) 100)
)

(assert (! (OptTest1.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun OptTest1.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptTest1!performance this) (/ (OptTest1!cost this) 10))
)

(assert (! (OptTest1.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun OptTest1.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptTest1!performance this) 50)
)

(assert (! (OptTest1.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Optimization Objectives (informational): ---

; (minimize (OptTest1!cost this))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-OptTest1 const-1-OptTest1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-OptTest1 () OptTest1
  (mk-OptTest1 500 50))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (cost (sel-OptTest1 (select heap 1))) 1000))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (performance (sel-OptTest1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (to_real (performance (sel-OptTest1 (select heap 1)))))
      (a!2 (to_real (cost (sel-OptTest1 (select heap 1))))))
  (<= a!1 (/ a!2 (to_real 10)))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OptTest1 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (cost (sel-OptTest1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (performance (sel-OptTest1 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (>= (performance (sel-OptTest1 (select heap 1))) 50))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-OptTest1 (mk-OptTest1 500 50))))
